name: AICardQueue
description: The AI Card Queue surfaces the live execution queue for an agent workstream, letting operators monitor progress, approve individual items, and pause or stop execution. It is the primary control surface for AI Led batch processing.
intent: Live view of an agent's execution queue with per-item approval controls, progress tracking, and pause/approve-all governance actions.
